text:
Zoe (Recruiter Ops): Heads-up  we pushed the new scorecard template to the ATS yesterday and a few interviewers at the training said fields looked squished / some required questions weren't marked. A couple panels reported they couldn't find the feedback free-text box after submitting.

Marco (Hiring Enablement): Thanks Zoe. Did we change any field IDs or just the UI layout? That can break integrations.

Zoe (Recruiter Ops): Marco I think both - layout + we renamed q4 to q4_alt to support shorter labels. I heard one interviewer say they pressed back in the browser and the draft looked empty.

Dina (People Ops): Not good. We need to avoid losing qualitative feedback. Can you capture sample candidate IDs so we can verify saved payloads? Also, we should add a short mandatory async module for all interviewers covering the new template.

Zoe (Recruiter Ops): Sample candidates: CAND-9950, CAND-9956. I confirm both panels submitted and saw a success toast but the ATS shows "no comments".

Alex (Platform): formbot shows a couple of non-fatal mapping warnings right after deploy: 
```
WARN mapper: unknown_key q4_alt -> dropped
WARN frontend: draft_save returned 202 but body empty
```
We probably need to map q4_alt -> q4 in the ingestion layer.

Marco (Hiring Enablement): Ok next steps from training side: 1) create a 6-min demo video showing where to find each field and the finalize flow; 2) add a one-slide checklist to the interview invite (confirm form loaded, finalize, avoid back nav). I can record the video today.

Dina (People Ops): I'll create an LMS assignment for the new template and mark it mandatory for all active interviewers. Also drafting a 2-line policy: "Always confirm finalize toast; if unsure, message recruiter within 15 min."

Zoe (Recruiter Ops): Creating ticket RECR-4199 for infra + ops to reconcile potentially dropped comments. Will attach logs.

Alex (Platform): RECR-4199 noted. Short-term patch: compatibility mapping q4_alt -> q4 in the mapper and an explicit client error when draft_save returns non-2xx. I can push a hotfix to staging. Also adding tighter client-side save confirmation.

formbot: deploy infra/form-mapper v1.2.4 -> staging by Alex succeeded

Marco (Hiring Enablement): For the async module, can we include 2 quick examples of good vs poor comments so interviewers understand expected length and phrasing? I'll add those.

Dina (People Ops): Nice. Also can we add a short QA checklist for interviewers who are new: 
- confirm candidate name/role at top of form
- don't use browser back during submission
- use finalize button (not close window)
- if you get any ambiguous success message, DM the recruiter

Zoe (Recruiter Ops): Action owners: Alex  mapper patch + log replay; Marco  record video + examples; Dina  LMS + policy note; Zoe  outreach to affected interviewers and verify comments after replay. I'll update RECR-4199 with progress.

Alex (Platform): For replay, plan to extract candidate payloads where comments are empty but request logs show non-empty payloads: 
```
SELECT req_id, payload->>'comments' as comments, received_at
FROM request_logs
WHERE path LIKE '%/scorecard%'
AND payload->>'comments' IS NOT NULL
AND stored_comments IS NULL
AND received_at >= now() - interval '48 hours';
```
I'll run dry-run first and post diffs to the ticket. ETA: EOD.

Marco (Hiring Enablement): Scheduling a 15-min live Q&A after the async goes out for anyone who wants to join. Will add to weekly interviewer sync agenda.

Dina (People Ops): After replay and mapping fix, we should add a short line to the hiring handbook about not editing scorecard templates during active panel windows. Prevent future live UI changes that touch field IDs.

Zoe (Recruiter Ops): Confirmed: outreach messages sent to interviewers for CAND-9950 and CAND-9956 asking for screenshots if they have them. Will drop updates here once Alex posts replay results. Thanks all :thumbsup:
